A '''''Gage''-class transport''' was active during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Its [[Unidentified Imperial captain (Gage-class transport)|captain]] had been disgraced, so as a last act of redemption he rammed his ship into a Republic battle station.<ref name="SW:TOR">{{TORcite|type=codex|Gage-class Transport}}</ref>
